name: Enno
description: Enno - a zero-config deep focus and site blocker Chrome extension.

scripts.preview:landing: npm run build:landing && vite preview --config vite.landing.config.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:landing && node scripts/build-static.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && start-server-and-test 'vite preview --config vite.landing.config.ts --port 8000' http://localhost:8000 'playwright test --browser=firefox'
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build && start-server-and-test 'vite preview --config vite.landing.config.ts --port 8000' http://localhost:8000 'playwright test --ui'
scripts.scan:lhci: npm run build:landing && node scripts/build-static.mjs && start-server-and-test 'vite preview --config vite.landing.config.ts --port 8000' http://localhost:8000 'npm run scan:lhci:themes'
scripts.scan:lhci:themes: npm run scan:lhci:light && npm run scan:lhci:dark
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
